1→/**
     2→ * AuctionLifecycle — closes ended auctions and runs a polling timer.
     3→ *
     4→ * Design decisions:
     5→ *  - No bids → NoSale; notify seller; release all holds (CLAUDE.md #1)
     6→ *  - Winner → Awarded; deduct deposit; notify all participants (CLAUDE.md #2)
     7→ *  - Timer polls every 15 s; first tab to update status "wins" (idempotent guard)
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { db } from '@/db'
    11→import { writeAuditLog } from '@/utils/audit'
    12→import { generateId } from '@/crypto'
    13→import { deductDeposit, releaseReservation } from './walletService'
    14→import { broadcast } from './bidChannel'
    15→import type { Auction } from '@/types'
    16→
    17→// ── closeAuction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    18→
    19→export async function closeAuction(auction: Auction): Promise<void> {
    20→  if (!['Active', 'Extended', 'Ended'].includes(auction.status)) return
    21→
    22→  const bids = await db.bids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
    23→
    24→  // ── No-bid scenario → NoSale ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    25→  if (bids.length === 0) {
    26→    await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'NoSale', updatedAt: Date.now() })
    27→
    28→    await writeAuditLog({
    29→      eventType: 'auction.no_sale',
    30→      actorId: 'system',
    31→      actorName: 'System',
    32→      entityType: 'Auction',
    33→      entityId: auction.id,
    34→      description: `Auction "${auction.title}" ended with no bids — marked No Sale`,
    35→    })
    36→
    37→    await db.notifications.add({
    38→      id: generateId(),
    39→      userId: auction.createdBy,
    40→      type: 'AuctionNoSale',
    41→      title: 'Auction Ended — No Sale',
    42→      message: `Your auction "${auction.title}" received no bids and has been marked as No Sale.`,
    43→      isRead: false,
    44→      relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
    45→      relatedEntityId: auction.id,
    46→      createdAt: Date.now(),
    47→    })
    48→
    49→    broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
    50→    return
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  // ── Determine winner: highest amount; tie → earliest createdAt ─────────────
    54→  const sorted = [...bids].sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount || a.createdAt - b.createdAt)
    55→  const winning = sorted[0] as (typeof sorted)[number] | undefined
    56→  if (!winning) return // guard — should not happen since bids.length > 0
    57→
    58→  await db.transaction(
    59→    'rw',
    60→    [db.auctions, db.proxyBids, db.wallets, db.walletTransactions, db.notifications, db.auditLogs],
    61→    async () => {
    62→      await db.auctions.update(auction.id, {
    63→        status: 'Awarded',
    64→        winnerId: winning.bidderId,
    65→        winningBidId: winning.id,
    66→        updatedAt: Date.now(),
    67→      })
    68→
    69→      // Deactivate all proxy bids
    70→      const proxies = await db.proxyBids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
    71→      await Promise.all(
    72→        proxies.map((p) => db.proxyBids.update(p.id, { isActive: false, updatedAt: Date.now() })),
    73→      )
    74→
    75→      // Deduct deposit from winner
    76→      await deductDeposit(winning.bidderId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)
    77→
    78→      // Release hold for all losing bidders
    79→      const loserIds = [...new Set(bids.map((b) => b.bidderId))].filter(
    80→        (id) => id !== winning.bidderId,
    81→      )
    82→      await Promise.all(
    83→        loserIds.map((loserId) => releaseReservation(loserId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)),
    84→      )
    85→
    86→      // Notify winner
    87→      await db.notifications.add({
    88→        id: generateId(),
    89→        userId: winning.bidderId,
    90→        type: 'AuctionWon',
    91→        title: 'You Won the Auction!',
    92→        message: `Congratulations! Your bid of ${String(winning.amount)} won "${auction.title}". A deposit of ${String(auction.depositAmount)} has been deducted from your wallet.`,
    93→        isRead: false,
    94→        relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
    95→        relatedEntityId: auction.id,
    96→        createdAt: Date.now(),
    97→      })
    98→
    99→      // Notify losers
   100→      await Promise.all(
   101→        loserIds.map((loserId) =>
   102→          db.notifications.add({
   103→            id: generateId(),
   104→            userId: loserId,
   105→            type: 'BidOutbid',
   106→            title: 'Auction Ended',
   107→            message: `The auction "${auction.title}" has ended. Your deposit hold has been released.`,
   108→            isRead: false,
   109→            relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
   110→            relatedEntityId: auction.id,
   111→            createdAt: Date.now(),
   112→          }),
   113→        ),
   114→      )
   115→
   116→      await writeAuditLog({
   117→        eventType: 'auction.closed',
   118→        actorId: 'system',
   119→        actorName: 'System',
   120→        entityType: 'Auction',
   121→        entityId: auction.id,
   122→        description: `Auction "${auction.title}" awarded to ${winning.bidderId} at ${String(winning.amount)}`,
   123→      })
   124→    },
   125→  )
   126→
   127→  broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
   128→}
   129→
   130→// ── Timer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   131→
   132→let _timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null
   133→
   134→/**
   135→ * Start a 15-second polling loop that closes any auctions whose endTime has passed.
   136→ * Returns a cleanup function — call it in a React useEffect cleanup.
   137→ */
   138→export function startAuctionLifecycleTimer(): () => void {
   139→  const tick = async () => {
   140→    const now = Date.now()
   141→    const toClose = await db.auctions
   142→      .where('status')
   143→      .anyOf('Active', 'Extended')
   144→      .filter((a) => a.endTime <= now)
   145→      .toArray()
   146→
   147→    for (const auction of toClose) {
   148→      // Atomic guard: only process if we successfully transition to Ended
   149→      const claimed = await db.transaction('rw', db.auctions, async () => {
   150→        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
   151→        if (!fresh || !['Active', 'Extended'].includes(fresh.status)) return false
   152→        await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'Ended', updatedAt: Date.now() })
   153→        return true
   154→      })
   155→
   156→      if (claimed) {
   157→        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
   158→        if (fresh) await closeAuction(fresh)
   159→      }
   160→    }
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  void tick()
   164→  _timer = setInterval(() => {
   165→    void tick()
   166→  }, 15_000)
   167→
   168→  return () => {
   169→    if (_timer !== null) {
   170→      clearInterval(_timer)
   171→      _timer = null
   172→    }
   173→  }
   174→}
   175→

1→/**

    10→export async function moderateContent(texts: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
    11→  const words = await db.sensitiveWords.toArray()

    13→
    14→  const combined = texts.join(' ').toLowerCase()
    15→  const flagged: string[] = []

    18→    // Whole-word match using word boundary pattern
    19→    const pattern = new RegExp(`\\b${word.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}\\b`, 'i')
    20→    if (pattern.test(combined)) {
    21→      flagged.push(word)
    22→    }
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  return [...new Set(flagged)]
    26→}

{"file_path": "/Users/muhammed/projects/eaglepoint/TASK-114/repo/README.md", "content": "# Meridian Offline Commerce & Compliance Portal

A 100% offline-first enterprise portal for auction management, document control, and publishing workflows. Built with React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Dexie.js (IndexedDB).

---

## Quick Start

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev        # development server at http://localhost:5173
pnpm build      # production build → dist/
pnpm test       # run all 65 unit + integration tests
pnpm lint       # ESLint with zero warnings policy
```

**Default login:** `admin` / `admin123` (temporary password — change on first login)

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer        | Technology                                         |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| UI Framework | React 19 + TypeScript                              |
| Build        | Vite with code splitting (React.lazy + Suspense)   |
| Styling      | Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens             |
| Persistence  | IndexedDB via Dexie.js (22 tables)                 |
| Preferences  | LocalStorage (session token, drawer state)         |
| Global State | Zustand                                            |
| Icons        | Lucide React                                       |
| Toasts       | Sonner                                             |
| Rich Text    | TipTap (StarterKit)                                |
| XSS          | DOMPurify                                          |

---

## Folder Structure

```
src/
├── auth/
│   └── permissions.ts        # Role-based permission matrix (23 permissions)
├── components/
│   ├── auction/              # BidForm, CountdownTimer
│   ├── auth/                 # ProtectedRoute
│   ├── layout/               # AppShell, NavDrawer, TabBar, TabContent, NotificationBell
│   └── ui/                   # Design system: Button, Input, Modal, Table, Badge, Card…
├── crypto/
│   ├── encryption.ts         # AES-GCM-256 encrypt/decrypt (Web Crypto API)
│   ├── ids.ts                # generateId() — crypto.randomUUID()
│   └── password.ts           # PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 (310,000 iterations)
├── db/
│   ├── database.ts           # MeridianDB Dexie class — all 22 tables + indexes
│   ├── index.ts              # Singleton db export
│   └── seeds.ts              # Default admin + categories seeded on first launch
├── hooks/
│   └── usePermission.ts      # usePermission(permission) hook for guarded UI
├── pages/
│   ├── admin/                # UserManagement, SystemSettings, SensitiveWords, AuditLog, DataExport
│   ├── auction/              # AuctionList/Form/Detail, Browse, MyBids, Wallet
│   ├── catalog/              # CatalogManagement, ItemForm, Browse, ModerationQueue
│   ├── documents/            # DocumentList, Form, Detail
│   ├── notifications/        # NotificationCenter, OutboundQueue
│   └── publishing/           # PublicationList/Form, ReviewQueue, ReviewDetail, Feed
├── services/
│   ├── auctionLifecycle.ts   # closeAuction(), startAuctionLifecycleTimer()
│   ├── auctionService.ts     # Auction CRUD, publish, cancel
│   ├── bidChannel.ts         # BroadcastChannel('meridian_bids') singleton
│   ├── biddingEngine.ts      # placeBid(), setProxyBid(), resolveProxies()
│   ├── catalogService.ts     # Catalog item CRUD + moderation + publish
│   ├── documentService.ts    # Document lifecycle: create→checkout→review→approve→destroy
│   ├── notificationService.ts# createNotification(), queueOutboundMessage(), bulk ops
│   ├── publicationService.ts # Publication lifecycle: draft→review→approve→publish
│   └── walletService.ts      # credit, debit, reserve, release, deductDeposit
├── store/
│   ├── authStore.ts          # Zustand: login, logout, session restore
│   ├── notificationStore.ts  # Zustand: notifications + BroadcastChannel sync
│   └── tabStore.ts           # Zustand: tab open/close/activate/dirty tracking
├── test/
│   ├── crypto/               # password, encryption, ids unit tests
│   ├── services/             # biddingEngine, moderation, docNumbering, lifecycle, workflow
│   └── utils/                # moderation unit tests
├── types/
│   ├── auction.ts            # Auction, Bid, ProxyBid, Wallet, WalletTransaction
│   ├── audit.ts              # AuditLog, AuditEventType (60+ event types)
│   ├── auth.ts               # User, Session, Role enum
│   ├── catalog.ts            # CatalogItem, Category, Tag
│   ├── document.ts           # Document, DocumentVersion, CheckoutRecord, RetentionPolicy, DestructionApproval
│   ├── notification.ts       # Notification, OutboundQueueItem, NotificationType
│   ├── publication.ts        # Publication, PublicationVersion, ViewEvent
│   ├── system.ts             # SystemConfig, SensitiveWord
│   └── index.ts              # Central re-export barrel
└── utils/
    ├── audit.ts              # writeAuditLog() — append-only, never updates
    ├── moderation.ts         # moderateContent() — whole-word regex against sensitiveWords
    └── sanitize.ts           # sanitizeHtml() — DOMPurify wrapper for dangerouslySetInnerHTML
```

---

## IndexedDB Schema

All 22 tables are declared in version 1 of the Dexie schema. Future breaking changes use version 2+.

| Table                | Primary Key | Key Indexes                                              |
| -------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `users`              | `id`        | `&username`, `role`, `isActive`                          |
| `sessions`           | `id`        | `userId`, `expiresAt`                                    |
| `auditLogs`          | `id`        | `actorId`, `entityType`, `entityId`, `createdAt`         |
| `auctions`           | `id`        | `status`, `createdBy`, `endTime`, `[status+endTime]`     |
| `bids`               | `id`        | `auctionId`, `bidderId`, `&idempotencyKey`, `createdAt`  |
| `proxyBids`          | `id`        | `auctionId`, `bidderId`, `isActive`, `[auctionId+isActive]` |
| `wallets`            | `id`        | `userId`                                                 |
| `walletTransactions` | `id`        | `walletId`, `userId`, `type`, `relatedAuctionId`         |
| `catalogItems`       | `id`        | `status`, `categoryId`, `*tags`, `createdBy`             |
| `categories`         | `id`        | `&slug`, `parentId`                                      |
| `tags`               | `id`        | `&slug`                                                  |
| `publications`       | `id`        | `status`, `createdBy`, `publishedAt`                     |
| `publicationVersions`| `id`        | `publicationId`, `createdAt`                             |
| `viewEvents`         | `id`        | `entityId`, `userId`, `openedAt`                         |
| `documents`          | `id`        | `status`, `documentNumber`, `categoryId`, `createdBy`, `retentionDueDate` |
| `documentVersions`   | `id`        | `documentId`, `createdAt`                                |
| `checkoutRecords`    | `id`        | `documentId`, `userId`, `isActive`                       |
| `retentionPolicies`  | `id`        | `documentType`                                           |
| `destructionApprovals`| `id`       | `documentId`, `status`                                   |
| `notifications`      | `id`        | `userId`, `isRead`, `createdAt`                          |
| `outboundQueue`      | `id`        | `status`, `recipientType`, `createdAt`                   |
| `systemConfig`       | `id`        | —                                                        |
| `sensitiveWords`     | `id`        | `&word`                                                  |

---

## Permission Matrix

Roles: `Administrator`, `ContentEditor`, `ReviewerApprover`, `Participant`

| Permission              | Admin | Editor | Reviewer | Participant |
| ----------------------- | :---: | :----: | :------: | :---------: |
| manageUsers             |  ✓   |        |          |             |
| manageSystem            |  ✓   |        |          |             |
| manageWallets           |  ✓   |        |          |             |
| viewAuditLog            |  ✓   |        |   ✓      |             |
| exportData              |  ✓   |        |          |             |
| createAuction           |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| editAuction             |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| publishAuction          |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| placeBid                |  ✓   |        |          |   ✓         |
| createCatalogItem       |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| editCatalogItem         |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| publishCatalogItem      |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| moderateCatalog         |  ✓   |        |   ✓      |             |
| createPublication       |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| editPublication         |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| approvePublication      |  ✓   |        |   ✓      |             |
| publishPublication      |  ✓   |        |   ✓      |             |
| createDocument          |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| editDocument            |  ✓   |   ✓    |          |             |
| approveDocument         |  ✓   |        |   ✓      |             |
| requestDestruction      |  ✓   |   ✓    |   ✓      |             |
| approveDestruction      |  ✓   |        |   ✓      |             |
| manageNotifications     |  ✓   |        |          |             |

Full implementation: `src/auth/permissions.ts`

---

## Security

- **Passwords**: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256, 310,000 iterations, 16-byte random salt, 256-bit output
- **Session tokens**: AES-GCM-256 encrypted in LocalStorage; master key generated once per device
- **Rich text**: All user-generated HTML sanitized with DOMPurify before rendering
- **Audit log**: Append-only — no delete or update paths exist in application code
- **Cross-tab**: BroadcastChannel + IndexedDB transactions + idempotency keys prevent duplicate bids
- **Moderation**: Sensitive-word scan runs on every save and submit-for-review

---

## Testing

65 tests across 10 test files using Vitest + fake-indexeddb:

| Test File                         | Coverage                                           |
| --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `crypto/password.test.ts`         | PBKDF2 hash format, uniqueness, verify, wrong creds |
| `crypto/encryption.test.ts`       | AES-GCM round-trip, unique IVs, tamper detection   |
| `crypto/ids.test.ts`              | UUID format, collision-free                         |
| `utils/moderation.test.ts`        | Empty list, case-insensitive, whole-word, multi-text, dedup |
| `services/biddingEngine.test.ts`  | Min increment, state guards, idempotency, anti-sniping, proxy |
| `services/documentNumbering.test.ts` | No number on Draft, formatted on Approved, sequential, retention date |
| `services/auctionLifecycle.test.ts` | Draft→Active, Awarded (winner/deposit/loser/notifications), NoSale |
| `services/publicationWorkflow.test.ts` | Full Draft→Published workflow, moderation block, notifications |
| `services/documentCheckout.test.ts` | Lock/block/audit/checkin/version/expired auto-release |
| `app.test.tsx`                    | App renders                                         |
"}

1→# Meridian Offline Commerce & Compliance Portal
     2→
     3→A 100% offline, browser-based enterprise portal for internal auctions, controlled document management, and regulated communications. Built with React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + IndexedDB (Dexie.js). No internet connection required at runtime.
     4→
     5→---
     6→
     7→## How to Run
     8→
     9→### Prerequisites
    10→
    11→- [Docker](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/) ≥ 24
    12→- [Docker Compose](https://docs.docker.com/compose/) ≥ 2.20 (bundled with Docker Desktop)
    13→
    14→### One-Click Start (Production Preview)
    15→
    16→```bash
    17→docker compose up
    18→```
    19→
    20→That is the only command needed. Docker will:
    21→
    22→1. Pull the `node:22-alpine` base image
    23→2. Install all dependencies via `pnpm` (no local Node/pnpm required)
    24→3. Build the static SPA with Vite
    25→4. Serve it on port **4173**
    26→
    27→### Development Mode (Hot-Reload)
    28→
    29→```bash
    30→docker compose --profile dev up dev
    31→```
    32→
    33→Source files are volume-mounted; Vite HMR updates the browser instantly on save.
    34→
    35→### Stop All Services
    36→
    37→```bash
    38→docker compose down
    39→```
    40→
    41→---
    42→
    43→## Services List
    44→
    45→| Service | Profile     | URL                   | Description              |
    46→| ------- | ----------- | --------------------- | ------------------------ |
    47→| `app`   | _(default)_ | http://localhost:4173 | Production preview build |
    48→| `dev`   | `dev`       | http://localhost:5173 | Vite dev server with HMR |
    49→| `test`  | `test`      | —                     | Vitest CI test runner    |
    50→
    51→---
    52→
    53→## Verification
    54→
    55→After `docker compose up`, verify the portal is running:
    56→
    57→**Browser**
    58→
    59→```
    60→Open http://localhost:4173
    61→```
    62→
    63→You should see the Meridian Portal landing screen.
    64→
    65→**curl / wget**
    66→
    67→```bash
    68→curl -I http://localhost:4173
    69→# Expected: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
    70→```
    71→
    72→**Docker health check**
    73→
    74→```bash
    75→docker inspect --format='{{.State.Health.Status}}' meridian-app
    76→# Expected: healthy  (after ~30 seconds)
    77→```
    78→
    79→**Compose status**
    80→
    81→```bash
    82→docker compose ps
    83→# Expected: meridian-app  running  0.0.0.0:4173->4173/tcp
    84→```
    85→
    86→---
    87→
    88→## Running Tests
    89→
    90→### Using the CI script (recommended)
    91→
    92→```bash
    93→# Run all tests once
    94→./run_tests.sh
    95→
    96→# Run with coverage report
    97→./run_tests.sh --coverage
    98→
    99→# Clean rebuild before running
   100→./run_tests.sh --clean
   101→
   102→# Watch mode (development)
   103→./run_tests.sh --watch
   104→```
   105→
   106→Coverage HTML report is written to `./coverage/index.html` on the host.
   107→
   108→### Using Docker Compose directly
   109→
   110→```bash
   111→docker compose --profile test up --exit-code-from test test
   112→```
   113→
   114→### CI Pipeline Example
   115→
   116→```yaml
   117→# GitHub Actions
   118→- name: Run tests
   119→  run: ./run_tests.sh --coverage
   120→```
   121→
   122→---
   123→
   124→## Tech Stack
   125→
   126→| Layer             | Technology               |
   127→| ----------------- | ------------------------ |
   128→| UI Framework      | React 19 + TypeScript    |
   129→| Build Tool        | Vite 6                   |
   130→| Styling           | Tailwind CSS 3           |
   131→| Persistence       | IndexedDB via Dexie.js 4 |
   132→| Global State      | Zustand 5                |
   133→| Icons             | Lucide React             |
   134→| Notifications     | Sonner                   |
   135→| Routing           | React Router 7           |
   136→| Testing           | Vitest + Testing Library |
   137→| Package Manager   | pnpm                     |
   138→| Container Runtime | Docker + Docker Compose  |
   139→
   140→---
   141→
   142→## Project Structure
   143→
   144→```
   145→src/
   146→├── crypto/       # PBKDF2 hashing, Web Crypto AES-GCM utilities
   147→├── db/           # Dexie database schema and migrations
   148→├── store/        # Zustand global state stores
   149→├── types/        # TypeScript interfaces and enums
   150→├── components/   # Reusable UI primitives
   151→├── pages/        # Route-level page components
   152→├── hooks/        # Custom React hooks
   153→├── utils/        # Pure utility functions
   154→└── test/         # Test setup and shared test utilities
   155→```
   156→
   157→---
   158→
   159→## Default Credentials
   160→
   161→On first launch, a default Administrator account is seeded automatically:
   162→
   163→| Field    | Value         |
   164→| -------- | ------------- |
   165→| Username | `admin`       |
   166→| Password | `Admin@1234!` |
   167→
   168→> **Change the default password immediately after first login.**

## Security

| Concern         | Implementation                                                      |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Passwords       | PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256, 310,000 iterations, 16-byte salt, 256-bit key  |
| Session tokens  | AES-GCM-256 encrypted in LocalStorage; per-device master key        |
| Rich text XSS   | DOMPurify sanitization before every `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` call  |
| Audit log       | Append-only — zero delete/update code paths exist in the codebase   |
| Duplicate bids  | Unique `idempotencyKey` index + Dexie `rw` transaction + BroadcastChannel |
| Moderation      | Sensitive-word scan on every save and submit-for-review             |

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# run_tests.sh — CI test runner for Meridian Portal
#
# Usage:
#   ./run_tests.sh              # run tests (builds image if needed)
#   ./run_tests.sh --coverage   # run tests + generate coverage report
#   ./run_tests.sh --watch      # run tests in watch mode (dev only)
#   ./run_tests.sh --clean      # remove test container + image before running
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

set -euo pipefail

IMAGE="meridian-portal:test"
CONTAINER="meridian-test"
COMPOSE_FILE="docker-compose.yml"

MODE="run"       # run | coverage | watch
CLEAN=false

# ── Parse args ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for arg in "$@"; do
  case $arg in
    --coverage) MODE="coverage" ;;
    --watch)    MODE="watch" ;;
    --clean)    CLEAN=true ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown argument: $arg"
      echo "Usage: $0 [--coverage] [--watch] [--clean]"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

# ── Clean up previous run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [ "$CLEAN" = true ]; then
  echo "→ Removing previous test container and image..."
  docker rm -f "$CONTAINER" 2>/dev/null || true
  docker rmi -f "$IMAGE"    2>/dev/null || true
fi

# ── Select pnpm script based on mode ─────────────────────────────────────────
case $MODE in
  coverage) CMD="pnpm test:coverage" ;;
  watch)    CMD="pnpm test:watch" ;;
  *)        CMD="pnpm test" ;;
esac

echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo "  Meridian Portal — Test Runner"
echo "  Mode    : $MODE"
echo "  Command : $CMD"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

# ── Build the test image ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "→ Building test image..."
docker build \
  --file Dockerfile.test \
  --tag "$IMAGE" \
  .

# ── Run the tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "→ Running tests..."
docker run \
  --rm \
  --name "$CONTAINER" \
  --env CI=true \
  --env NODE_ENV=test \
  --volume "$(pwd)/coverage:/app/coverage" \
  "$IMAGE" \
  sh -c "$CMD"

EXIT_CODE=$?

# ── Result summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  ✓ All tests passed"
  if [ "$MODE" = "coverage" ]; then
    echo "  Coverage report: ./coverage/index.html"
  fi
else
  echo "  ✗ Tests failed (exit code: $EXIT_CODE)"
fi
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

exit $EXIT_CODE

Done. Here's what changed:

- **`RegisterPage.tsx`** — full self-registration form for buyers: username (regex-validated), display name, optional email, password + confirm. On submit: checks uniqueness → PBKDF2 hash → `db.users.add(Role.Participant)` → audit log → auto-login.
- **`LoginPage.tsx`** — accepts `onRegister` prop; shows "New buyer? Create an account" link below the card.
- **`App.tsx`** — `view` state (`'login' | 'register'`) controls which page renders when unauthenticated.
- **`authStore.ts`** — `buyer` removed from seeded accounts; only `admin`, `editor`, and `reviewer` are seeded.
- **`README.md`** — updated demo accounts table to 3 staff accounts + a "Registering as a Buyer" section.

To test: clear IndexedDB (DevTools → Application → IndexedDB → Delete database) and refresh, then use `admin`/`editor`/`reviewer` to log in as staff, or click "New buyer? Create an account" to self-register.

1→/**
     2→ * AES-GCM-256 symmetric encryption using the Web Crypto API.
     3→ *
     4→ * Usage pattern for session tokens in LocalStorage:
     5→ *   1. Call `generateEncryptionKey()` once on first app load.
     6→ *   2. Persist the key with `exportKey()` → store in LocalStorage as "masterKey".
     7→ *   3. Restore on subsequent loads with `importKey()`.
     8→ *   4. Use `encrypt()` / `decrypt()` for any sensitive value.
     9→ *
    10→ * Wire format: base64( IV[12 bytes] || Ciphertext )
    11→ *   - Random 12-byte IV is prepended to ciphertext so each call is unique.
    12→ *   - AES-GCM authentication tag (16 bytes) is appended automatically by the API.
    13→ */
    14→
    15→const IV_LENGTH = 12 // bytes — standard for AES-GCM
    16→
    17→// ── Internal helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    18→
    19→function bufferToBase64(buffer: ArrayBuffer): string {
    20→  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer)
    21→  let binary = ''
    22→  for (const byte of bytes) {
    23→    binary += String.fromCharCode(byte)
    24→  }
    25→  return btoa(binary)
    26→}
    27→
    28→function base64ToUint8Array(base64: string): Uint8Array {
    29→  const binary = atob(base64)
    30→  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length)
    31→  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
    32→    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i)
    33→  }
    34→  return bytes
    35→}
    36→
    37→// ── Key management ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    38→
    39→/**
    40→ * Generate a fresh AES-GCM-256 encryption key.
    41→ * Call once per device/browser; persist via `exportKey`.
    42→ */
    43→export async function generateEncryptionKey(): Promise<CryptoKey> {
    44→  return crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, true, ['encrypt', 'decrypt'])
    45→}
    46→
    47→/**
    48→ * Export a CryptoKey to a base64 string safe for LocalStorage.
    49→ */
    50→export async function exportKey(key: CryptoKey): Promise<string> {
    51→  const raw = await crypto.subtle.exportKey('raw', key)
    52→  return bufferToBase64(raw)
    53→}
    54→
    55→/**
    56→ * Re-import a CryptoKey previously exported with `exportKey`.
    57→ */
    58→export async function importKey(base64: string): Promise<CryptoKey> {
    59→  const raw = base64ToUint8Array(base64).buffer
    60→  return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', raw, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, true, [
    61→    'encrypt',
    62→    'decrypt',
    63→  ])
    64→}
    65→
    66→// ── Encrypt / Decrypt ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    67→
    68→/**
    69→ * Encrypt a UTF-8 plaintext string.
    70→ * Returns a base64-encoded string containing IV + ciphertext + GCM auth tag.
    71→ */
    72→export async function encrypt(plaintext: string, key: CryptoKey): Promise<string> {
    73→  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(IV_LENGTH))
    74→  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(plaintext)
    75→  const ciphertext = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, key, encoded)
    76→
    77→  // Combine IV + ciphertext into a single buffer
    78→  const combined = new Uint8Array(IV_LENGTH + ciphertext.byteLength)
    79→  combined.set(iv, 0)
    80→  combined.set(new Uint8Array(ciphertext), IV_LENGTH)
    81→
    82→  return bufferToBase64(combined.buffer)
    83→}
    84→
    85→/**
    86→ * Decrypt a value previously encrypted with `encrypt`.
    87→ * Throws a DOMException if the key is wrong or the ciphertext is tampered.
    88→ */
    89→export async function decrypt(base64Ciphertext: string, key: CryptoKey): Promise<string> {
    90→  const combined = base64ToUint8Array(base64Ciphertext)
    91→  const iv = combined.slice(0, IV_LENGTH)
    92→  const ciphertext = combined.slice(IV_LENGTH)
    93→
    94→  const decrypted = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, key, ciphertext)
    95→  return new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted)
    96→}

 * Runtime permission enforcement for the service layer.
 *
 * Call `requirePermission(permission)` at the top of any service function

 * This provides defense-in-depth on top of the UI-level guards (usePermission

 */

import { useAuthStore } from '@/store/authStore'
import { hasPermission, type Permission } from '@/auth/permissions'
import type { Role } from '@/types'

/**
 * Throws an `Error` if the currently-authenticated user does not have
 * `permission`. Call at the top of any service mutation.
 */
export function requirePermission(permission: Permission): void {
  const role = useAuthStore.getState().currentUser?.role as Role | undefined
  if (!role || !hasPermission(role, permission)) {
    throw new Error(`Forbidden: '${permission}' permission required`)
  }
}
"}

 * Runtime permission enforcement for the service layer.
 *
 * Call `requirePermission(permission)` at the top of any service function
 * that mutates data. It reads the current user from the Zustand auth store
 * and throws if the role lacks the required permission.
 *
 * This provides defense-in-depth on top of the UI-level guards (usePermission
 * hook, NavDrawer item visibility).
 */

import { useAuthStore } from '@/store/authStore'
import { hasPermission } from '@/auth/permissions'
import type { Permission } from '@/auth/permissions'

/**
 * Throws an `Error` if the currently-authenticated user does not have
 * `permission`. Call at the top of any service mutation.
 */
export function requirePermission(permission: Permission): void {
  const user = useAuthStore.getState().currentUser
  if (!user || !hasPermission(user.role, permission)) {
    throw new Error(`Forbidden: '${permission}' permission required`)
  }
}
"}

- **Security-critical coverage:** **Partial** — crypto and `requirePermission` unit tests exist; **missing** tests for page-level privilege escalation (tab + admin pages).

**Major gaps (up to 3)**

1. No automated test that a Participant (or non-admin) cannot load or use `UserManagementPage` / other admin surfaces.
2. No E2E flow for login → role-limited navigation → forbidden deep link/tab.
3. Build pipeline not validated in tests (`tsc -b` failure would not be caught by Vitest alone).

**Final test verdict:** **Partial Pass**

[main f0acae6] test(security): add PermissionGuard privilege-escalation tests
 2 files changed, 302 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 repo/src/test/layout/tabContentPermissions.test.tsx

Done. Here's what was added to address the test sufficiency gaps:

**New: `src/test/layout/tabContentPermissions.test.tsx` — 22 tests**

Covers all 6 `PermissionGuard`-wrapped routes:

| Route | Permission | Denied roles tested | Allowed role tested |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/admin/users` | `manageUsers` | Participant, ContentEditor, Reviewer | Administrator |
| `/admin/settings` | `manageSystem` | Participant, ContentEditor, Reviewer | Administrator |
| `/admin/sensitive-words` | `manageSystem` | Participant | Administrator |
| `/admin/audit-log` | `viewAuditLog` | Participant, ContentEditor | Reviewer, Administrator |
| `/admin/export` | `manageSystem` | Participant | Administrator |
| `/outbound-queue` | `manageMessages` | Participant, ContentEditor, Reviewer | Administrator |
| *(unauthenticated)* | all | `currentUser: null` on `/admin/users` + `/outbound-queue` | — |

Each denied test confirms both that "Access Denied" is present **and** the real page stub is absent — guarding against a false positive from partial rendering.

Gap 2 (E2E) and Gap 3 (tsc in CI) remain as noted — E2E would require adding Playwright which is a separate investment; tsc is already run by `pnpm build` which should be part of any CI pipeline.

### 1 — High

- **Conclusion:** Message Center requirements for **scheduled/rule-triggered delivery**, **retry (3 attempts at 1/5/15 minutes)**, **templates**, **read receipts**, and **subscription preferences** are not implemented in the notification domain model or service layer.
- **Rationale:** Prompt treats these as core Message Center capabilities; code provides CRUD-style in-app notifications and a simple outbound queue without retry scheduling or those fields.
- **Evidence:** `OutboundQueueItem` has no retry/attempt/next-run fields (`repo/src/types/notification.ts` L45–58). `notificationService.ts` exposes queue/mark sent/failed/requeue but **no** 1/5/15 minute retry logic (file ends at L145; `grep` for `retry` / `attempt` in that service: no matches).
- **Impact:** Prompt fit and completeness gap in a named primary module.
- **Minimum fix:** Extend schema + worker/timer (or lifecycle hook) for outbound retries; add minimal UI + types for templates, read receipts, and subscription prefs, or document explicit scope reduction.

### 2 — High

- **Conclusion:** **Participant “completes trainings”** (and any training workspace) is **not** present in the reviewed codebase.
- **Rationale:** Prompt lists training completion under Participant responsibilities; no training routes, types, or pages were found.
- **Evidence:** `grep` across `repo/src` for `train|Training` (case-insensitive): no relevant matches.
- **Impact:** Explicit role scenario missing.
- **Minimum fix:** Add a training module (list, progress, completion state in IndexedDB) or formally descope with stakeholder sign-off.

### 3 — High

- **Conclusion:** **Anti-sniping** behavior **differs** from the prompt’s literal reading (“when a valid bid is placed in the last 30 seconds”) vs **one extension per auction** after the first qualifying bid.
- **Rationale:** Strict acceptance uses prompt as source of truth; README/CLAUDE document a product decision for “once.”
- **Evidence:** `repo/src/services/biddingEngine.ts` L171–177: extension only when `!auction.antiSnipingTriggered` and within 30s window; sets `antiSnipingTriggered: true` (L183). README “Anti-sniping rule” section states once-per-auction behavior.
- **Impact:** Functional spec mismatch unless prompt is formally amended.
- **Minimum fix:** Align implementation with prompt (repeat extensions) or update prompt/contract to match `antiSnipingTriggered` semantics.

### 4 — Medium

- **Conclusion:** **Content & Search** prompt items **brand** / **spec** filters, **keyword suggestions from recent searches**, and **trending keywords (7 days)** are missing or only partially reflected in the browse experience.
- **Rationale:** Browse page implements category, price, tags, text search, and sort including `top_sellers`; no recent-search or trending implementation found; brand exists on the type but is not used as a browse facet in the UI reviewed.
- **Evidence:** `CatalogBrowsePage.tsx` facets: category, price, tags (`L129–221`); no brand/spec/trending/recent-search state. `CatalogItem` includes optional `brand` (`repo/src/types/catalog.ts` L9–10). Repository-wide `grep` for `trending|recentSearch` under `src`: no matches.
- **Impact:** Incomplete catalog/search story vs prompt.
- **Minimum fix:** Persist recent searches (LocalStorage), compute 7-day trending from stored events, add brand/spec filters in UI.

### 5 — Medium

- **Conclusion:** **Default deposit** policy (**10% of starting price, minimum $50**) is not enforced or prefilled in the auction authoring UI; deposit is a free numeric field.
- **Rationale:** Prompt describes a default threshold; form validates `>= 0` only.
- **Evidence:** `AuctionFormPage.tsx` L42–43, L84–85: `depositAmount` manual entry; validation `da < 0` only, no `max(50, 0.1*startPrice)` default.
- **Impact:** Operators can publish auctions inconsistent with stated business rules unless they know the policy.
- **Minimum fix:** Compute default on `startPrice` change and optionally allow override with warning.

### 6 — Medium

- **Conclusion:** **Page-level RBAC** is **inconsistent**: admin and some message routes use `PermissionGuard` in `TabContent.tsx`; many feature routes (e.g. `/auctions/new`, `/catalog/...`) render **without** a guard, relying on **service-layer** `requirePermission` and nav visibility.
- **Rationale:** Defense in depth: unauthorized users could still open a tab path (e.g. via devtools/store) and see editor UIs until submit fails.
- **Evidence:** `TabContent.tsx` L185: `/auctions/new` → `<AuctionFormPage />` with no `PermissionGuard`. Compare L302–306: `/admin/users` wrapped in `PermissionGuard`. `requirePermission` in `repo/src/utils/permissions.ts` L20–24 throws on missing permission.
- **Impact:** Weaker page-level access control and UX vs prompt’s RBAC expectations; not necessarily data corruption if all mutations are guarded (auction create uses `createAuction` → `requirePermission('createAuction')` per `auctionService.ts` grep).
- **Minimum fix:** Wrap each route in `PermissionGuard` with the same permission as the service entry point.

### 7 — Medium

- **Conclusion:** **`ProtectedRoute` + `react-router-dom`** are **not integrated** into the running app shell; routing is **tab-path matching** inside `TabContent`, while `main.tsx` mounts `App` without a router.
- **Rationale:** Prompt asks for “client-side routing”; dependency exists but primary navigation is tab-store paths, not URL-synced routes—deep linking and `ProtectedRoute` behavior are effectively unused in production entry.
- **Evidence:** `repo/src/main.tsx` L9–13: no `BrowserRouter`. `grep` for `ProtectedRoute` / `BrowserRouter` in `src`: only `ProtectedRoute.tsx` itself and docs. `App.tsx` switches login vs `AppShell` by auth state.
- **Impact:** Architecture diverges from stated stack; dead or misleading auth route component.

### 9 — Low / Medium

- **Conclusion:** **Bid “Results” / history** shows amounts, times, truncated bidder id, and a **(proxy)** flag, but **extension events** are not first-class rows in the timeline (only a banner + auction field).

### 10 — Low

- **Conclusion:** **`react-router-dom`** is a dependency but **not** used in the main entry path—adds maintenance surface and confusion with README references to “React Router 7.”

     2→import { useAuthStore } from '@/store/authStore'
     3→import { hasPermission, type Permission } from '@/auth/permissions'
     4→
     5→interface Props {
     6→  /** Required permission to access this route. If omitted, any authenticated user may access it. */
     7→  permission?: Permission
     8→  children: React.ReactNode
     9→}
    10→
    11→/**
    12→ * Wraps a route element and enforces authentication + optional permission checks.
    13→ *
    14→ * - Unauthenticated → redirects to `/login`
    15→ * - Authenticated but missing permission → redirects to `/unauthorized`
    16→ * - Otherwise → renders `children`
    17→ */
    18→export function ProtectedRoute({ permission, children }: Props) {
    19→  const currentUser = useAuthStore((s) => s.currentUser)
    20→
    21→  if (!currentUser) {
    22→    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  if (permission && !hasPermission(currentUser.role, permission)) {
    26→    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" replace />
    27→  }
    28→
    29→  return <>{children}</>
    30→}

    13→// ── In-app notifications ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    14→
    15→export interface CreateNotificationInput {

    18→  title: string
    19→  message: string

    23→
    24→export async function createNotification(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<void> {
    25→  await db.notifications.add({
    26→    id: generateId(),
    27→    ...input,
    28→    isRead: false,
    29→    createdAt: Date.now(),
    30→  })
    31→}
    32→
    33→/** Create the same notification for multiple users at once. */
    34→export async function createNotificationForMany(
    35→  userIds: string[],
    36→  fields: Omit<CreateNotificationInput, 'userId'>,
    37→): Promise<void> {
    38→  const now = Date.now()
    39→  await db.notifications.bulkAdd(
    40→    userIds.map((userId) => ({
    41→      id: generateId(),
    42→      userId,
    43→      ...fields,
    44→      isRead: false,
    45→      createdAt: now,
    46→    })),
    47→  )
    48→}

    50→export async function markNotificationRead(id: string): Promise<void> {
    51→  await db.notifications.update(id, { isRead: true })

    54→export async function markAllNotificationsRead(userId: string): Promise<void> {
    55→  await db.notifications

    57→    .equals(userId)

     5→export interface Tab {
     6→  /** Unique stable ID for this tab instance */
     7→  id: string
     8→  /** Display title shown in the tab strip */
     9→  title: string
    10→  /** Route path the tab renders — drives the content area */
    11→  path: string
    12→  /** When true, shows a dot indicator and blocks close without confirmation */
    13→  isDirty: boolean
    14→}
    15→
    16→// ── Store ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    17→
    18→interface TabState {
    19→  tabs: Tab[]
    20→  activeTabId: string | null
    21→}
    22→
    23→interface TabActions {
    24→  openTab: (tab: Omit<Tab, 'isDirty'>) => void
    25→  closeTab: (tabId: string) => void
    26→  activateTab: (tabId: string) => void
    27→  markDirty: (tabId: string, dirty: boolean) => void
    28→}
    29→
    30→// Dashboard is the permanent home tab — it cannot be closed.
    31→const HOME_TAB: Tab = {
    32→  id: 'home',
    33→  title: 'Dashboard',
    34→  path: '/',
    35→  isDirty: false,
    36→}
    37→
    38→export const useTabStore = create<TabState & TabActions>((set, get) => ({
    39→  tabs: [HOME_TAB],
    40→  activeTabId: HOME_TAB.id,
    41→
    42→  // ── openTab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    43→  // If a tab with the same path already exists, activate it instead of duplicating.
    44→  openTab: (incoming) => {
    45→    const { tabs } = get()
    46→    const existing = tabs.find((t) => t.path === incoming.path)
    47→    if (existing) {
    48→      set({ activeTabId: existing.id })
    49→      return
    50→    }
    51→    const newTab: Tab = { ...incoming, isDirty: false }
    52→    set({ tabs: [...tabs, newTab], activeTabId: newTab.id })
    53→  },
    54→
    55→  // ── closeTab ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    56→  // Never closes the home tab.  After close, activates the nearest remaining tab.
    57→  closeTab: (tabId) => {
    58→    const { tabs, activeTabId } = get()
    59→    if (tabId === HOME_TAB.id) return
    60→
    61→    const idx = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.id === tabId)
    62→    if (idx === -1) return

1→/**
     2→ * NotificationStore — reactive unread count + notification list.
     3→ *
     4→ * Kept lightweight: loads on demand, refreshed via `refresh()`.
     5→ * BroadcastChannel sync ensures the bell updates when another tab
     6→ * triggers a new notification.

     9→import { create } from 'zustand'
    10→import { db } from '@/db'
    11→import { markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead } from '@/services/notificationService'
    12→import type { Notification } from '@/types'
    13→
    14→const CHANNEL_NAME = 'meridian_notifications'
    15→
    16→interface NotificationState {
    17→  notifications: Notification[]
    18→  unreadCount: number
    19→  isLoading: boolean
    20→  refresh: (userId: string) => Promise<void>
    21→  markRead: (id: string, userId: string) => Promise<void>
    22→  markAllRead: (userId: string) => Promise<void>
    23→}
    24→
    25→export const useNotificationStore = create<NotificationState>((set, get) => ({
    26→  notifications: [],
    27→  unreadCount: 0,
    28→  isLoading: false,
    29→
    30→  refresh: async (userId: string) => {
    31→    set({ isLoading: true })
    32→    const all = await db.notifications.where('userId').equals(userId).reverse().sortBy('createdAt')
    33→    set({
    34→      notifications: all,
    35→      unreadCount: all.filter((n) => !n.isRead).length,
    36→      isLoading: false,
    37→    })
    38→  },
    39→
    40→  markRead: async (id: string, userId: string) => {
    41→    await markNotificationRead(id)
    42→    await get().refresh(userId)
    43→    broadcastRefresh()
    44→  },
    45→
    46→  markAllRead: async (userId: string) => {
    47→    await markAllNotificationsRead(userId)
    48→    await get().refresh(userId)
    49→    broadcastRefresh()
    50→  },
    51→}))
    52→
    53→// ── BroadcastChannel sync ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    54→
    55→let channel: BroadcastChannel | null = null
    56→
    57→/** Broadcast a refresh signal to other tabs. */
    58→function broadcastRefresh(): void {
    59→  channel?.postMessage({ type: 'refresh' })
    60→}
    61→
    62→/**
    63→ * Call once at app startup (after auth) to listen for cross-tab notification events.
    64→ * Returns a cleanup function.
    65→ */
    66→export function startNotificationSync(userId: string): () => void {
    67→  if (typeof BroadcastChannel === 'undefined') return () => undefined
    68→
    69→  channel = new BroadcastChannel(CHANNEL_NAME)
    70→  const handler = (e: MessageEvent<{ type: string }>) => {
    71→    if (e.data.type === 'refresh') {
    72→      void useNotificationStore.getState().refresh(userId)
    73→    }
    74→  }
    75→  channel.addEventListener('message', handler)
    76→
    77→  return () => {
    78→    channel?.removeEventListener('message', handler)
    79→    channel?.close()
    80→    channel = null
    81→  }
    82→}

    85→export function broadcastNewNotification(): void {
    86→  if (typeof BroadcastChannel === 'undefined') return
    87→  const ch = new BroadcastChannel(CHANNEL_NAME)
    88→  ch.postMessage({ type: 'refresh' })

// ── Document & Archive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type DocumentStatus =
  | 'Draft'
  | 'InReview'
  | 'Approved'
  | 'Rejected'
  | 'Archived'
  | 'PendingDestruction'
  | 'Destroyed'

export type DestructionApprovalStatus =
  | 'Pending'
  | 'ReviewerApproved' // step 1 of 2
  | 'FullyApproved' // both Reviewer + Admin approved
  | 'Rejected'

export interface Document {
  id: string
  /**
   * Assigned only on Draft → Approved transition.
   * Format: `{PREFIX}-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}` e.g. ORG-2026-000001
   * Per decision #6: undefined until approved to avoid numbering gaps.
   */
  documentNumber?: string
  title: string
  /** e.g. 'Policy' | 'Procedure' | 'Form' | 'Manual' */
  type: string
  categoryId: string
  body: string
  attachmentUrls: string[]
  status: DocumentStatus
  currentVersionId?: string
  /** userId who currently holds the exclusive checkout lock */
  checkedOutBy?: string
  checkedOutAt?: number
  /** Auto-release checkout after this timestamp if user does not check in */
  checkoutExpiresAt?: number
  /** Retention period in years (copied from RetentionPolicy at creation time) */
  retentionYears: number
  /** Epoch ms — set when document reaches Approved status */
  retentionDueDate?: number
  moderationFlags: string[]
  createdBy: string
  createdAt: number
  updatedAt: number
}

export interface DocumentVersion {
  id: string
  documentId: string
  versionNumber: number
  title: string
  body: string
  status: DocumentStatus
  reviewComment?: string

 * appKey — shared AES-GCM master key accessor.
 *
 * The key is generated once per browser profile and persisted in LocalStorage
 * as a base-64 exported raw key.  It is reused for:
 *   - Session-token encryption (authStore)
 *   - Wallet balance encryption at rest (walletService)
 *   - Document title/body encryption at rest (documentService)
 *
 * Keeping a single key (vs. one per domain) is intentional for this
 * offline-only application: there is no server key-management service, so
 * the threat model is limited to physical access to the raw IndexedDB files.
 * Separate keys would add ceremony without meaningfully reducing that risk.
 */

import { generateEncryptionKey, exportKey, importKey } from './encryption'

const LS_ENC_KEY = 'meridian_enc_key'

let _cached: CryptoKey | null = null

/**
 * Return the device-scoped AES-GCM-256 master key.
 * Creates and persists a new key on first call; subsequent calls return the
 * in-memory cached instance (or re-import from LocalStorage after a reload).
 */
export async function getAppKey(): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  if (_cached) return _cached
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(LS_ENC_KEY)
  if (stored) {
    _cached = await importKey(stored)
    return _cached
  }
  const key = await generateEncryptionKey()
  localStorage.setItem(LS_ENC_KEY, await exportKey(key))
  _cached = key
  return key
}
"}

    16→async function recordTransaction(
    17→  walletId: string,
    18→  userId: string,
    19→  type: WalletTransactionType,
    20→  amount: number,
    21→  description: string,
    22→  createdBy: string,
    23→  relatedAuctionId?: string,
    24→): Promise<void> {

    28→    userId,
    29→    type,
    30→    amount,
    31→    description,
    32→    createdBy,
    33→    relatedAuctionId,

    36→}

    38→// ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    39→
    40→/** Ensure a wallet record exists for the user; create one (zero balance) if not. */
    41→export async function ensureWallet(userId: string): Promise<void> {
    42→  const existing = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
    43→  if (!existing) {
    44→    await db.wallets.add({
    45→      id: generateId(),
    46→      userId,
    47→      balance: 0,
    48→      reservedAmount: 0,
    49→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    50→    })
    51→  }
    52→}
    53→
    54→/** Credit (add funds) to a user's wallet. Admin-initiated manual top-up. */
    55→export async function creditWallet(
    56→  userId: string,
    57→  amount: number,
    58→  description: string,
    59→  actorId: string,
    60→  relatedAuctionId?: string,
    61→): Promise<void> {
    62→  if (amount <= 0) throw new Error('Credit amount must be positive')
    63→  await ensureWallet(userId)
    64→
    65→  await db.transaction('rw', db.wallets, db.walletTransactions, async () => {
    66→    const wallet = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
    67→    if (!wallet) throw new Error('Wallet not found')
    68→    await db.wallets.update(wallet.id, {
    69→      balance: wallet.balance + amount,
    70→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    71→    })
    72→    await recordTransaction(
    73→      wallet.id,
    74→      userId,
    75→      'Credit',
    76→      amount,
    77→      description,
    78→      actorId,
    79→      relatedAuctionId,
    80→    )
    81→  })
    82→}
    83→
    84→/** Debit (remove funds) from a user's wallet. Throws if insufficient available balance. */
    85→export async function debitWallet(
    86→  userId: string,
    87→  amount: number,
    88→  description: string,
    89→  actorId: string,
    90→  relatedAuctionId?: string,
    91→): Promise<void> {
    92→  if (amount <= 0) throw new Error('Debit amount must be positive')
    93→
    94→  await db.transaction('rw', db.wallets, db.walletTransactions, async () => {
    95→    const wallet = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
    96→    if (!wallet) throw new Error('Wallet not found')
    97→    const available = wallet.balance - wallet.reservedAmount
    98→    if (available < amount) throw new Error('Insufficient wallet balance')
    99→    await db.wallets.update(wallet.id, {
   100→      balance: wallet.balance - amount,
   101→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
   102→    })
   103→    await recordTransaction(
   104→      wallet.id,
   105→      userId,
   106→      'Debit',
   107→      amount,
   108→      description,
   109→      actorId,
   110→      relatedAuctionId,
   111→    )
   112→  })
   113→}
   114→
   115→/**
   116→ * Reserve an amount in the wallet (hold without deducting from balance).
   117→ * Replaces any existing reservation for the same auction so re-bidding works correctly.
   118→ */
   119→export async function reserveForAuction(
   120→  userId: string,
   121→  auctionId: string,
   122→  newReserveAmount: number,
   123→  previousReserveAmount: number,
   124→): Promise<void> {
   125→  await db.transaction('rw', db.wallets, db.walletTransactions, async () => {
   126→    const wallet = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
   127→    if (!wallet) throw new Error('Wallet not found')
   128→
   129→    const delta = newReserveAmount - previousReserveAmount
   130→    const available = wallet.balance - wallet.reservedAmount
   131→    if (delta > 0 && available < delta)
   132→      throw new Error('Insufficient wallet balance for deposit hold')
   133→
   134→    await db.wallets.update(wallet.id, {
   135→      reservedAmount: wallet.reservedAmount + delta,
   136→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
   137→    })
   138→    if (delta !== 0) {
   139→      const type: WalletTransactionType = delta > 0 ? 'Reserve' : 'Release'
   140→      await recordTransaction(
   141→        wallet.id,
   142→        userId,
   143→        type,
   144→        Math.abs(delta),
   145→        `Deposit hold adjusted for auction ${auctionId}`,
   146→        userId,
   147→        auctionId,
   148→      )
   149→    }
   150→  })
   151→}

   153→/** Release the reserved hold when an auction ends without the user winning. */
   154→export async function releaseReservation(
   155→  userId: string,
   156→  auctionId: string,
   157→  reservedAmount: number,
   158→): Promise<void> {

   165→      reservedAmount: Math.max(0, wallet.reservedAmount - reservedAmount),

   175→      auctionId,
   176→    )
   177→  })

     4→ * Design decisions (per CLAUDE.md #2):
     5→ *  - Deduct deposit ONLY on auction win.
     6→ *  - During active bidding, hold a "reserved" amount (no deduction yet).
     7→ *  - All mutations are wrapped in Dexie transactions for atomicity.
     8→ *
     9→ * Security: `balance` and `reservedAmount` are stored as AES-GCM-256
    10→ * ciphertext in `encBalance` / `encReservedAmount`.  Every read decrypts
    11→ * these fields before arithmetic; every write re-encrypts the updated values.
    12→ * Use `getWallet()` / `getWalletById()` to obtain the decrypted representation.
    13→ */

    15→import { db } from '@/db'
    16→import { generateId } from '@/crypto'
    17→import { encrypt, decrypt } from '@/crypto/encryption'
    18→import { getAppKey } from '@/crypto/appKey'
    19→import type { Wallet, WalletDecrypted, WalletTransactionType } from '@/types'

    21→// ── Encryption helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    22→
    23→async function encNum(value: number): Promise<string> {
    24→  const key = await getAppKey()
    25→  return encrypt(String(value), key)
    26→}
    27→
    28→async function decNum(cipher: string): Promise<number> {
    29→  const key = await getAppKey()
    30→  return Number(await decrypt(cipher, key))
    31→}
    32→
    33→async function decryptWallet(w: Wallet): Promise<WalletDecrypted> {
    34→  const [balance, reservedAmount] = await Promise.all([
    35→    decNum(w.encBalance),
    36→    decNum(w.encReservedAmount),
    37→  ])
    38→  return { id: w.id, userId: w.userId, balance, reservedAmount, updatedAt: w.updatedAt }
    39→}
    40→
    41→// ── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    42→
    43→async function recordTransaction(
    44→  walletId: string,
    45→  userId: string,
    46→  type: WalletTransactionType,
    47→  amount: number,
    48→  description: string,
    49→  createdBy: string,
    50→  relatedAuctionId?: string,
    51→): Promise<void> {
    52→  await db.walletTransactions.add({
    53→    id: generateId(),
    54→    walletId,
    55→    userId,
    56→    type,
    57→    amount,
    58→    description,
    59→    createdBy,
    60→    relatedAuctionId,
    61→    createdAt: Date.now(),
    62→  })
    63→}

    65→// ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    67→/** Ensure a wallet record exists for the user; create one (zero balance) if not. */
    68→export async function ensureWallet(userId: string): Promise<void> {
    69→  const existing = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
    70→  if (!existing) {
    71→    await db.wallets.add({
    72→      id: generateId(),
    73→      userId,
    74→      encBalance: await encNum(0),
    75→      encReservedAmount: await encNum(0),
    76→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    77→    })
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/** Return the decrypted wallet for a user, or null if none exists. */
    82→export async function getWallet(userId: string): Promise<WalletDecrypted | null> {
    83→  const w = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
    84→  return w ? decryptWallet(w) : null
    85→}
    86→
    87→/** Credit (add funds) to a user's wallet. Admin-initiated manual top-up. */
    88→export async function creditWallet(
    89→  userId: string,
    90→  amount: number,
    91→  description: string,
    92→  actorId: string,
    93→  relatedAuctionId?: string,
    94→): Promise<void> {

    96→  await ensureWallet(userId)
    97→
    98→  await db.transaction('rw', db.wallets, db.walletTransactions, async () => {
    99→    const wallet = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
   100→    if (!wallet) throw new Error('Wallet not found')
   101→    const plain = await decryptWallet(wallet)
   102→    await db.wallets.update(wallet.id, {
   103→      encBalance: await encNum(plain.balance + amount),
   104→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
   105→    })
   106→    await recordTransaction(

   108→      userId,
   109→      'Credit',
   110→      amount,
   111→      description,
   112→      actorId,
   113→      relatedAuctionId,
   114→    )
   115→  })
   116→}
   117→
   118→/** Debit (remove funds) from a user's wallet. Throws if insufficient available balance. */
   119→export async function debitWallet(
   120→  userId: string,
   121→  amount: number,
   122→  description: string,
   123→  actorId: string,
   124→  relatedAuctionId?: string,
   125→): Promise<void> {

   127→

   131→    const plain = await decryptWallet(wallet)

   133→    if (available < amount) throw new Error('Insufficient wallet balance')
   134→    await db.wallets.update(wallet.id, {
   135→      encBalance: await encNum(plain.balance - amount),
   136→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
   137→    })
   138→    await recordTransaction(
   139→      wallet.id,
   140→      userId,
   141→      'Debit',
   142→      amount,
   143→      description,
   144→      actorId,
   145→      relatedAuctionId,
   146→    )
   147→  })
   148→}
   149→
   150→/**
   151→ * Reserve an amount in the wallet (hold without deducting from balance).
   152→ * Replaces any existing reservation for the same auction so re-bidding works correctly.
   153→ */
   154→export async function reserveForAuction(
   155→  userId: string,
   156→  auctionId: string,
   157→  newReserveAmount: number,
   158→  previousReserveAmount: number,
   159→): Promise<void> {
   160→  await db.transaction('rw', db.wallets, db.walletTransactions, async () => {
   161→    const wallet = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
   162→    if (!wallet) throw new Error('Wallet not found')
   163→    const plain = await decryptWallet(wallet)
   164→
   165→    const delta = newReserveAmount - previousReserveAmount
   166→    const available = plain.balance - plain.reservedAmount
   167→    if (delta > 0 && available < delta)
   168→      throw new Error('Insufficient wallet balance for deposit hold')
   169→
   170→    await db.wallets.update(wallet.id, {
   171→      encReservedAmount: await encNum(plain.reservedAmount + delta),
   172→      updatedAt: Date.now(),
   173→    })
   174→    if (delta !== 0) {

   176→      await recordTransaction(

   178→        userId,
   179→        type,
   180→        Math.abs(delta),
   181→        `Deposit hold adjusted for auction ${auctionId}`,
   182→        userId,
   183→        auctionId,
   184→      )
   185→    }
   186→  })
   187→}

   192→  auctionId: string,
   193→  reservedAmount: number,

1→/**
     2→ * AuctionLifecycle — closes ended auctions and runs a polling timer.
     3→ *
     4→ * Design decisions:
     5→ *  - No bids → NoSale; notify seller; release all holds (CLAUDE.md #1)
     6→ *  - Winner → Awarded; deduct deposit; notify all participants (CLAUDE.md #2)
     7→ *  - Timer polls every 15 s; first tab to update status "wins" (idempotent guard)
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { db } from '@/db'
    11→import { writeAuditLog } from '@/utils/audit'
    12→import { generateId } from '@/crypto'
    13→import { deductDeposit, releaseReservation } from './walletService'
    14→import { broadcast } from './bidChannel'
    15→import type { Auction } from '@/types'
    16→
    17→// ── closeAuction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    18→
    19→export async function closeAuction(auction: Auction): Promise<void> {
    20→  if (!['Active', 'Extended', 'Ended'].includes(auction.status)) return
    21→
    22→  const bids = await db.bids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
    23→
    24→  // ── No-bid scenario → NoSale ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    25→  if (bids.length === 0) {
    26→    await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'NoSale', updatedAt: Date.now() })
    27→
    28→    await writeAuditLog({
    29→      eventType: 'auction.no_sale',
    30→      actorId: 'system',
    31→      actorName: 'System',
    32→      entityType: 'Auction',
    33→      entityId: auction.id,
    34→      description: `Auction "${auction.title}" ended with no bids — marked No Sale`,
    35→    })
    36→
    37→    await db.notifications.add({
    38→      id: generateId(),
    39→      userId: auction.createdBy,
    40→      type: 'AuctionNoSale',
    41→      title: 'Auction Ended — No Sale',
    42→      message: `Your auction "${auction.title}" received no bids and has been marked as No Sale.`,
    43→      isRead: false,
    44→      relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
    45→      relatedEntityId: auction.id,
    46→      createdAt: Date.now(),
    47→    })
    48→
    49→    broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
    50→    return
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  // ── Determine winner: highest amount; tie → earliest createdAt ─────────────
    54→  const sorted = [...bids].sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount || a.createdAt - b.createdAt)
    55→  const winning = sorted[0] as (typeof sorted)[number] | undefined
    56→  if (!winning) return // guard — should not happen since bids.length > 0
    57→
    58→  await db.transaction(
    59→    'rw',
    60→    [db.auctions, db.proxyBids, db.wallets, db.walletTransactions, db.notifications, db.auditLogs],
    61→    async () => {
    62→      await db.auctions.update(auction.id, {
    63→        status: 'Awarded',
    64→        winnerId: winning.bidderId,
    65→        winningBidId: winning.id,
    66→        updatedAt: Date.now(),
    67→      })
    68→
    69→      // Deactivate all proxy bids
    70→      const proxies = await db.proxyBids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
    71→      await Promise.all(
    72→        proxies.map((p) => db.proxyBids.update(p.id, { isActive: false, updatedAt: Date.now() })),
    73→      )
    74→
    75→      // Deduct deposit from winner
    76→      await deductDeposit(winning.bidderId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)
    77→
    78→      // Release hold for all losing bidders
    79→      const loserIds = [...new Set(bids.map((b) => b.bidderId))].filter(
    80→        (id) => id !== winning.bidderId,
    81→      )
    82→      await Promise.all(
    83→        loserIds.map((loserId) => releaseReservation(loserId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)),
    84→      )
    85→
    86→      // Notify winner
    87→      await db.notifications.add({
    88→        id: generateId(),
    89→        userId: winning.bidderId,
    90→        type: 'AuctionWon',
    91→        title: 'You Won the Auction!',
    92→        message: `Congratulations! Your bid of ${String(winning.amount)} won "${auction.title}". A deposit of ${String(auction.depositAmount)} has been deducted from your wallet.`,
    93→        isRead: false,
    94→        relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
    95→        relatedEntityId: auction.id,
    96→        createdAt: Date.now(),
    97→      })
    98→
    99→      // Notify losers
   100→      await Promise.all(
   101→        loserIds.map((loserId) =>
   102→          db.notifications.add({
   103→            id: generateId(),
   104→            userId: loserId,
   105→            type: 'BidOutbid',
   106→            title: 'Auction Ended',
   107→            message: `The auction "${auction.title}" has ended. Your deposit hold has been released.`,
   108→            isRead: false,
   109→            relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
   110→            relatedEntityId: auction.id,
   111→            createdAt: Date.now(),
   112→          }),
   113→        ),
   114→      )
   115→
   116→      await writeAuditLog({
   117→        eventType: 'auction.closed',
   118→        actorId: 'system',
   119→        actorName: 'System',
   120→        entityType: 'Auction',
   121→        entityId: auction.id,
   122→        description: `Auction "${auction.title}" awarded to ${winning.bidderId} at ${String(winning.amount)}`,
   123→      })
   124→    },
   125→  )
   126→
   127→  broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
   128→}
   129→
   130→// ── Timer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   131→
   132→let _timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null
   133→
   134→/**
   135→ * Start a 15-second polling loop that closes any auctions whose endTime has passed.
   136→ * Returns a cleanup function — call it in a React useEffect cleanup.
   137→ */
   138→export function startAuctionLifecycleTimer(): () => void {
   139→  const tick = async () => {
   140→    const now = Date.now()
   141→    const toClose = await db.auctions
   142→      .where('status')
   143→      .anyOf('Active', 'Extended')
   144→      .filter((a) => a.endTime <= now)
   145→      .toArray()
   146→
   147→    for (const auction of toClose) {
   148→      // Atomic guard: only process if we successfully transition to Ended
   149→      const claimed = await db.transaction('rw', db.auctions, async () => {
   150→        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
   151→        if (!fresh || !['Active', 'Extended'].includes(fresh.status)) return false
   152→        await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'Ended', updatedAt: Date.now() })
   153→        return true
   154→      })
   155→
   156→      if (claimed) {
   157→        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
   158→        if (fresh) await closeAuction(fresh)
   159→      }
   160→    }
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  void tick()
   164→  _timer = setInterval(() => {
   165→    void tick()
   166→  }, 15_000)
   167→
   168→  return () => {
   169→    if (_timer !== null) {
   170→      clearInterval(_timer)
   171→      _timer = null
   172→    }
   173→  }
   174→}

1→/**
     2→ * appKey — shared AES-GCM master key accessor.
     3→ *
     4→ * The key is generated once per browser profile and persisted in LocalStorage
     5→ * as a base-64 exported raw key.  It is reused for:
     6→ *   - Session-token encryption (authStore)
     7→ *   - Wallet balance encryption at rest (walletService)
     8→ *   - Document title/body encryption at rest (documentService)
     9→ *
    10→ * Keeping a single key (vs. one per domain) is intentional for this
    11→ * offline-only application: there is no server key-management service, so
    12→ * the threat model is limited to physical access to the raw IndexedDB files.
    13→ * Separate keys would add ceremony without meaningfully reducing that risk.
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { generateEncryptionKey, exportKey, importKey } from './encryption'
    17→
    18→const LS_ENC_KEY = 'meridian_enc_key'
    19→
    20→let _cached: CryptoKey | null = null
    21→
    22→/**
    23→ * Return the device-scoped AES-GCM-256 master key.
    24→ * Creates and persists a new key on first call; subsequent calls return the
    25→ * in-memory cached instance (or re-import from LocalStorage after a reload).
    26→ */
    27→export async function getAppKey(): Promise<CryptoKey> {
    28→  if (_cached) return _cached
    29→  const stored = localStorage.getItem(LS_ENC_KEY)
    30→  if (stored) {
    31→    _cached = await importKey(stored)
    32→    return _cached
    33→  }
    34→  const key = await generateEncryptionKey()
    35→  localStorage.setItem(LS_ENC_KEY, await exportKey(key))
    36→  _cached = key
    37→  return key
    38→}

1→/**
     2→ * AES-GCM-256 symmetric encryption using the Web Crypto API.
     3→ *
     4→ * Usage pattern for session tokens in LocalStorage:
     5→ *   1. Call `generateEncryptionKey()` once on first app load.
     6→ *   2. Persist the key with `exportKey()` → store in LocalStorage as "masterKey".
     7→ *   3. Restore on subsequent loads with `importKey()`.
     8→ *   4. Use `encrypt()` / `decrypt()` for any sensitive value.
     9→ *
    10→ * Wire format: base64( IV[12 bytes] || Ciphertext )
    11→ *   - Random 12-byte IV is prepended to ciphertext so each call is unique.
    12→ *   - AES-GCM authentication tag (16 bytes) is appended automatically by the API.
    13→ */
    14→
    15→const IV_LENGTH = 12 // bytes — standard for AES-GCM
    16→
    17→// ── Internal helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    18→
    19→function bufferToBase64(buffer: ArrayBuffer): string {
    20→  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer)
    21→  let binary = ''
    22→  for (const byte of bytes) {
    23→    binary += String.fromCharCode(byte)
    24→  }
    25→  return btoa(binary)
    26→}

[main 8f63aa29] fix(security): encrypt wallet balances + document content at rest; fix test bugs
 19 files changed, 616 insertions(+), 282 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 repo/src/crypto/appKey.ts

All 191 tests pass and the build succeeds. Here's a summary of what was fixed:

**Root causes of the 6 failing tests:**

1. **`OperationError: Cipher job failed`** — Race condition in `getAppKey()`: when `ensureWallet` called `Promise.all([encNum(0), encNum(0)])`, both concurrent calls saw `_cached = null`, each generated a different key, and the last one overwrote `_cached`. Subsequent decryption used the wrong key. Fixed with a `_pending` guard so concurrent callers share one in-flight Promise.

2. **`Error: Wallet not found`** — `prepareReservation` was called before checking if the auction exists. Tests that pass a non-existent auction don't seed a wallet, so it threw before returning the expected "Auction not found" message. Fixed with a pre-flight auction check before the wallet reservation.

3. **`TransactionInactiveError`** (4 tests in `auctionLifecycle`) — `deductDeposit` and `releaseReservation` do Web Crypto inside a Dexie transaction, causing the same PrematureCommitError pattern. Fixed by moving them outside the transaction, keeping only pure IndexedDB writes (auction status, proxy deactivation) inside the transaction scope.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# run_tests.sh — full test suite for Meridian Portal
#
# Usage:
#   ./run_tests.sh              # lint + type-check + unit tests + build
#   ./run_tests.sh --coverage   # same + generate coverage report
#   ./run_tests.sh --tests-only # unit tests only (skip lint/type-check/build)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

MODE="full"   # full | coverage | tests-only

for arg in "$@"; do
  case $arg in
    --coverage)   MODE="coverage" ;;
    --tests-only) MODE="tests-only" ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown argument: $arg"
      echo "Usage: $0 [--coverage] [--tests-only]"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

PASS=0
FAIL=0

run_step() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  echo ""
  echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
  echo "  $label"
  echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
  if "$@"; then
    echo "  ✓ $label passed"
    PASS=$((PASS + 1))
  else
    echo "  ✗ $label FAILED"
    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
  fi
}

echo ""
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo "  Meridian Portal — Test Suite  (mode: $MODE)"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

if [ "$MODE" = "full" ] || [ "$MODE" = "coverage" ]; then
  run_step "Lint (ESLint)"           pnpm lint
  run_step "Format check (Prettier)" pnpm format:check
  run_step "Type check (tsc)"        pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
fi

if [ "$MODE" = "coverage" ]; then
  run_step "Unit tests + coverage (Vitest)" pnpm test:coverage
else
  run_step "Unit tests (Vitest)" pnpm test --run
fi

if [ "$MODE" = "full" ] || [ "$MODE" = "coverage" ]; then
  run_step "Production build" pnpm build
fi

echo ""
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo "  Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo ""

if [ "$MODE" = "coverage" ] && [ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "  Coverage report: ./coverage/index.html"
  echo ""
fi

[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]

FROM node:22-alpine AS deps

# Install pnpm
RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml* ./

RUN npm install -g serve@14

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist

EXPOSE 4173

CMD ["serve", "--single", "--listen", "4173", "dist"]

COPY . .
